page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.16xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V3 processor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 256 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. Network performance is supported by a 34 Gbps baseline bandwidth, managed via the Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in multi-core processing, memory bandwidth, and database operations. The server achieves top-tier ratings in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. Memory performance is highly efficient, with cached read-only small block bandwidth reaching top-tier levels and large block read/write operations performing in the top 25%. Single-core performance and LLM inference speeds for small and medium models fall within the average range.

The ARM-based architecture and integrated high-capacity NVMe SSD storage deliver high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency by reducing the need for external storage attachments. The server is optimized for multi-threaded workloads, database operations, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving. It is well-suited for Redis deployments, static web serving, and data-intensive applications requiring fast local storage.
